verdict.rationale: Stripe documents spend limits and revocation at the shared payment token level: the issuing agent sets currency, maximum amount and expiration, and can revoke the SPT at any time so the seller can't charge it, with webhooks for state changes. Link CLI also requires the customer to approve every spend request, and RAK permissions can restrict what an agent does in an account. These controls are per-token or per-request, though, not a standing per-agent budget that a user can set and then revoke for that agent in one action. Missing for 10: user-configurable aggregate per-agent spend caps and usage quotas, a single control to instantly revoke an agent's entire payment authority, independent or hands-on corroboration.
